Unless you are a contractor and need battery powered tools for mobility, corded power tools & a nice set of extensions cords are the way to go. Corded power tools are more powerful, you don't have to worry about battery life, and you don't need to replace expensive batteries after a few years. You can have the same tool for decades, and it will still function when you want to use it. I exchange all battery powered tools that I receive as gifts for a proper corded tool.
Buy it for life: A nice corded power tool and a set of extension cords is exponentially better than battery powered power tools for the average homeowner.
